title: Holiday / Ad-hoc Opening Calendar
description: Maintain exception dates for the exit/dispatch calendar by state — only two kinds exist: Holiday (dispatch stops for the range, exit stays normal) and Ad-hoc weekend opening (exit stays open for the range, dispatch is left alone). Affects settlement rules in features like Dispatch Performance.
emptyText: No exception dates for this state
dateRangeHint: Pick a range for a multi-day holiday — the whole range is added as the same kind. For a single day, pick the same start and end date.
rangeTooLong: At most {{max}} days per batch — split longer ranges into multiple additions
kindHolidayHint: No dispatch counted and no drivers run during this range; exit is left alone and follows the default rule (morning pickup runs as usual). The dispatch deadline automatically rolls to 23:59:59 of the first normal dispatch day after the range.
kindAdhocOpenHint: Exit stays open during this range even on weekends, instead of waiting for the next workday; dispatch is left alone and follows the default rule (drivers may not follow).
notePlaceholder: e.g. NSW public holiday / ad-hoc weekend sorting
confirmRemoveContent: This date will revert to the default rule (Mon–Fri).
